import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    d=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    print('changed:', [(a,b) for _,_,a,b in d])

import os,re,json

a=G['Demo pair 5 input']; b=G['Demo pair 5 output']
# Hypothesis: each colored seed expands CHEBYSHEV-distance-wise with priority to nearest same-color seed, 
# but ONLY through cells adjacent (Chebyshev 1) to another seed of ANY color... test "must have same-color seed at Chebyshev dist <=2"?
def solve(inp,k):
    inp=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=5
    res=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[i][c]!=bg: continue
            cand=[]
            for s_i,s_c,s_v in [(r_,e,a[r_][e]) for r_ in range(H) for e in range(W) if a[r_][e]!=bg]:
                d=max(abs(s_i-i),abs(s_c-c)); cand.append((d,s_v))
            m=min(x[0] for x in cand)
            mine=[x for x in cand if x[0]<=m+k and x[1]==cand[cand.index(min(cand,key=lambda z:(z[0],-z[1])))[0]][1]]
            # simpler: pick best among those with d<=m+k
            best=None;bb=9**9
            for d,v in cand:
                if d<=m+k: bb=min(bb,d); best=v
            res[i][c]=best
    return res
for k in [1,2]:
    r=solve(a,k)
    diff=[(i,c,b[i][c],r[i][c]) for i in range(13) for c in range(27) if r[i][c]!=b[i][c]]
    print(k,len(diff),diff[:8])

steps.input:
def analyze(name):
    inp=G[name+' input'];out=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(inp,bg)
    transforms=[]
    T_=cs[0]['cells'] if False else None
    def variants(cells):
        h=max(p[0]for p in cells);w=max(p[1]for p in cells)
        outs={}
        for nm,f in [('id',lambda r,c:(r,c)),('vfl',lambda r,c:(h-r,c)),('hfl',lambda r,c:(r,w-1-c)),
                     ('rot',lambda r,c:(c,h-r))]:
            tr=[f(r,c) for r,c in cells]
            th=max(r for r,c in tr);tw=max(c for r,c in tr)
            outs[nm]=frozenset((r-min(a for a,b in tr),c-min(b for a,b in tr)) for a,b in tr)
        return outs
    allvar={t:variants(T['cells']) for t,T in enumerate([c for c in cs if len(c['cells'])>1])}
    for s in cs:
        if len(s['cells'])!=1: continue
        scell=s['cells'][0];col=s['color']
        co=comps(out,bg)
        target=None
        for c in co:
            if (scell[0],scell[1]) in c['cells']:
                target=c; break
        if not target:
            print(name,col,'seed',scell,'NO OUT COMP');continue
        yc=[p[0]for p in target['cells']];xc=[p[1]for p in target['cells']]
        my=min(yc);mx=min(xc)
        norm=frozenset((r-my,c-mx) for r,c in target['cells'])
        hit=None
        for ti,vs in allvar.items():
            for nm,vn in vs.items():
                if vn==norm: hit=(ti,nm);break
            if hit:break
        print(name,col,'seed',scell,'matches big comp #',hit,'outsize',len(target['cells']))

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 5 input'];out=G['Demo pair 5 output']
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bg=collections.Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
cs=comps(inp,bg)
from collections import defaultdict
ch=defaultdict(list)
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        if inp[i][j]==bg and out[i][j]!=bg: ch[out[i][j]].append((i,j))
# For each seed color, find nearest big comp of a different color and check template match
singles=sorted([c for c in cs if len(c['cells'])==1],key=lambda s:s['cells'][0])
big=sorted([c for c in cs if len(c['cells'])>1],key=lambda s:s['cells'][0])
for s in singles:
    scell=s['cells'][0]; col=s['color']
    # which added cells of same color are near this seed?
    near=[p for p in ch[col] if abs(p[0]-scell[0])+abs(p[1]-scell[1])<=4]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 4 input']; out=G['Demo pair 4 output']
print(inp==out)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 4 input']; out=G['Demo pair 4 output']
print('bg color:', Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0])
